_about: Multi-turn conversations: each turn is parsed and folded into the case the way IntakeWalker does (parse_intake, then merge_profiles with the previous turn's profile and the question being answered). Expectations are checked on the merged profile after each turn. Written from a hard-test pass on 2026-09-30: people switch languages mid-conversation (code-switching is normal in immigrant families), add a second need, answer a follow-up with a bare number, or disclose violence in one language and continue in another.
